Achha madam, ek baat. Labour ka total 14.quote: Achha madam, ek baat. Labour ka total 14 hazaar tay hua tha na?

Nahi nahi, 13 hazaar tay hua tha. Aapne.text: Sunita says the agreed total was 13,000 rupees.
Nahi nahi, 13 hazaar tay hua tha. Aapne.quote: Nahi nahi, 13 hazaar tay hua tha. Aapne khud last bola tha.
